source.title: Strabane Chronicle, 14 June 1958, p. 2 ("Notice of Result of Elections: Rural District of Strabane, 1958")
source.publisher: Strabane Chronicle (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Strabane Chronicle, 14 June 1958, p. 2, block images read): the only candidate entered for the division, no poll having been taken

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. Ballymagorry was contested (Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1958, p. 5). The Belfast News-Letter of 21 May 1958, p. 11 also reported a contest in Ardstraw, but the Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Strabane Chronicle, 14 June 1958, p. 2) enters a single candidate there; all 28 divisions are recorded from the notice. Returned unopposed.
